# SISMN LLC

> Texas Licensed & Board Certified Architecture, Civil & Structural Engineering, Real Estate Acquisition, and Construction Management Firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

## Corporate Identity & Statutory Accreditations
- **Company Name**: SISMN LLC
- **Legal Jurisdiction**: State of Texas, United States
- **Headquarters**: 13151 Emily Rd. #100, Dallas, TX 75240
- **Direct Phone**: (214) 453-9999
- **Email**: info@sismnllc.com
- **Website**: https://sismnllc.com
- **President & Founder**: Imran Pirzada
- **Texas Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors (TBPELS)**: Firm Registration #F-10492
- **Texas Board of Architectural Examiners (TBAE)**: Architectural Firm Registration #BR-4902
- **Track Record**: 25+ Years of Leadership, 250+ Cities Covered, 2,000+ Completed Valuations & Deliveries, $300M+ Project Pipeline

## Core Disciplines & Professional Capabilities
1. **Architectural Design & Space Planning**: Conceptual architecture, commercial shopping centers, luxury residential master plans, construction documentation, and Texas Accessibility Standards (TAS/ADA) compliance.
2. **Structural & Civil Engineering**: Board-certified structural calculations, foundation designs, post-tensioned slabs, civil site utilities, stormwater detention, and drainage analysis.
3. **Real Estate Acquisition Consulting**: Comprehensive site selection, zoning analysis, municipal entitlement processing, land feasibility, and platting.
4. **Full-Lifecycle Construction Management**: Owner representation, general contracting oversight, QA/QC site inspections, and turn-key delivery.
5. **Capital Placement & Joint Ventures**: Feasibility modeling, institutional syndication advisory, and commercial investment structuring.

## Key Signature Developments
- **The Vineyards** (Cedar Hill, TX): Multi-acre master-planned residential community featuring custom topography, dedicated parkways, and modern underground infrastructure.
- **The Mya Heights** (Rowlett, TX): High-density luxury community located near Lake Ray Hubbard with contemporary facades and energy-efficient systems.
- **Savana Avenue** (Carrollton, TX): 12,000 SF retail center paired with 30 residential condominiums and integrated parking deck.
- **Shahla Homes** (Lancaster, TX): Custom suburban single-family subdivision with comprehensive civil infrastructure.
- **Silver Saddle Court** (Grand Prairie, TX): 18-unit premium duplex residential community engineered with precision stormwater systems.
- **Clarksville General Hospital** (Clarksville, TX): Full-service acute care medical and hospital facility with medical-grade MEP, surgical suites, and trauma center.
